key_terms.ثَمُودَ: Thamud, an ancient Arab tribe known for building structures in stone
key_terms.فِرْعَوْنَ: Pharaoh, the king of Egypt during the time of Prophet Moses (AS)

ai.seo_question: Who are Pharaoh and Thamud in the context of Quranic history?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the juxtaposition of Pharaoh and Thamud highlights the archetypal struggle between divine authority and tyrannical arrogance, serving as a precursor to the ultimate victory of the Ahl al-Bayt over their enemies. This pairing underscores the Quranic theme that worldly power, no matter how immense, is transient when contrasted with the enduring truth of prophethood.
